test_title: PYST 36: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 28 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s). 

Statements:

Some Magpies are Swans.

No Swans are Seagulls.

Conclusions:

I: Some Magpies are Seagulls.

II: No Seagulls are Magpies.
solution:
​The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13d77ae11dcd479d59b3852d47b8dd4928136d903251bd50e413e29a27b7bef3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Magpies are Seagulls → Does not follow.(As some Magpies are Swans and no Swans are Seagulls. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. No Seagulls are Magpies → Does not follow.(As some Magpies are Swans and no Swans are Seagulls. It is possible that some Magpies (who are not Swans) could be Seagulls.)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
